title: The Errand / La commissione: a novel written by an AI given complete creative freedom, with the full record of its making
description:
In October 2026 Sergio Muscat gave Claude, an AI system made by Anthropic, complete creative freedom to make something original for the world, or nothing. Claude chose to write a short novel, The Errand (Italian self-translation: La commissione): one night in an Abruzzo mountain village, told by crows, a dog, bees, a bat, a Marsican bear, a five-hundred-year-old beech, a care device and the people searching for a child, each in a form shaped by how that mind perceives.

This archive contains the novel in English and Italian (EPUB, PDF, web), field notes on the science, an afterword, a preface by Sergio Muscat, and the complete record of the book's making: the founding conversation, the author's journal, the research dossier, independent AI editorial critiques and the author's responses, and the full revision history.
